_draft: NOT YET AN AUTHORIZATION RECORD. The operator's brief of 2026-11-14 ('CO.PRE.PAN_v3 – Erste Realqualifikation von Backup und Intake ...') authorises exactly this intake; the brief names no end date. The run that executes it on a weekday, after BACKUP_VERIFIED and seed-cache, sets valid_until to that day (the narrowest validity the brief allows), removes this key, saves the record ONCE as config/intake/authorizations/<that day>_in2-canary.json and commits it once; scripts/intake_operator.py start refuses this file as it is (unknown key, empty valid_until, not under config/intake/authorizations/).
conditions: one start; a second needs a new record
every gate of scripts/intake_operator.py start, none switched off
no request to a held origin or URL; nothing is worked around
the switch is disabled again when it ends, whatever its outcome
a weekday; CO.RA.PAN's observation SHARE_NORMAL at the start; the backup BACKUP_VERIFIED; the manifest cache seeded (brief §4)
no second canary, no 24-hour wave, no recurring acquisition, no backfill, no lifting of an access hold

clauses: §0: „Explizite Operatorfreigabe dieses Auftrags: Ein einziger Intake mit ID in2-20261114-canary, genau den sieben bereits geplanten Outlets, höchstens drei Stunden und höchstens 300 HTTP-Requests.“
